1 - Light air - Direction of wind shown by smoke drift but not by wind vanes (1-3 knots)
2 - Light breeze - Wind felt on face; leaves rustle; wind vanes move (4-6 knots)
3 - Gentle breeze - Leaves and small twigs in constant motion; wind extends light flag (7-10 knots)
4 - Moderate breeze - Raises dust and loose paper; small branches are moved (11-16 knots)
5 - Fresh breeze - small branches in trees begin to sway; crested wavelets form on inland waters (17-21)
6 - Strong breeze - Large branches in motion; umbrellas used with difficulty (22-27 knots)
7 - Near gale - Whole trees in motion; inconvenience felt when walking against wind (28-33 knots)
8 - Gale - Breaks twigs off trees; generally impedes progress (34-40 knots)
9 - Severe gale - Slight structural damage occurs (chimney pots and slates removed) (41-47 knots)
10 - Storm - Seldom experienced inland; trees uprooted, considerable structural damage (48-55 knots)
11 - Violent storm - Very rarely experienced; accompanied by widespread damage (56-63 knots)
12 - Hurricane force - Extremely rare; devastation and loss of life (64+ knots)
